title: Scientific/probabilistic verification
canonical_definition: Support workload-specific validation where full recomputation is impractical.

roadmap_order.note: CMP-1.4.4 remains open. CMP-1.4.8 adds workload-specific scientific/probabilistic evidence and does not claim signed-verdict completion.

milestone_relationship.rationale: CMP-1.4.8 is the first point where deterministic full-recomputation adapters and scientific/probabilistic validation coexist. Cross-family typing and the retained Compute verifier suite must prove the two methods cannot be silently substituted.

implementation.method_rule: Scientific adapters validate bounded workload-specific evidence under an exact versioned protocol commitment; sampled PASS is not represented as exact full recomputation.
implementation.sampling_rule: A dedicated sampling authority freezes a nonzero sample-seed commitment before execution; the reference adapter reveals it only with post-result evidence and derives a unique fixed sample plan deterministically.
implementation.membership_rule: The reference adapter authenticates every sampled observation against the dataset Merkle root committed by the job input.
implementation.outcome_rule: Scientific evidence produces explicit INCONCLUSIVE/PASS/FAIL outcomes. The router records evidence but does not mutate ComputeJobRegistry420 verdict or settlement state.
implementation.family_rule: Deterministic and scientific adapters expose distinct adapter-kind identities and both registries reject cross-family publication.

reference_protocol.note: This bounded reference profile is intended for public/non-sensitive committed integer datasets. It is not a statistical-confidence guarantee, not a generic scientific correctness proof, and not suitable for private samples that cannot be disclosed in calldata.

authority_boundaries: Scientific adapter publication grants no verifier identity/class/capability, signed verdict, settlement, custody, stake/slash, worker, governance, validator, bridge or wallet authority.
The sampling authority can freeze only a scientific route/sample commitment; it cannot create a job verdict, select a settlement beneficiary, move funds, or change the accepted verification policy.
Adapter code hash, output schema and protocol commitment are frozen per job before execution; later publication/deactivation cannot rewrite historical semantics.
PASS means only that the exact sampled/tolerance protocol passed. It is not represented as exact full-dataset correctness.
FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE does not automatically transition the canonical job or create economic consequences.
Malformed seed reveals, wrong Merkle membership, wrong worker output commitment, cross-family adapter substitution and replay fail closed.
Private workload/sample bytes are not required by the generic interface; the concrete reference sampled-mean profile is explicitly public/non-sensitive only.
exit_criteria: A generic scientific/probabilistic adapter interface exists with exact workload/profile/schema/protocol identity and explicit INCONCLUSIVE/PASS/FAIL evidence outcomes.
A versioned governance registry pins exact scientific adapter address, runtime code hash, schema and protocol commitment.
An exact scientific route and sample-plan commitment are frozen before execution by a dedicated sampling authority.
Post-result evaluation binds the accepted verification policy, canonical job/result, actual worker output commitment and exact frozen adapter code/protocol.
The reference sampled-mean adapter verifies deterministic sample selection, Merkle membership and objective tolerance/dispersion rules without full dataset recomputation.
PASS is not represented as exact correctness; high-dispersion evidence is explicitly INCONCLUSIVE and out-of-tolerance evidence is FAIL.
Malformed seed/proof/output evidence and replay fail closed without mutating canonical job verdict/settlement state.
Deterministic and scientific adapter families cannot be cross-published or silently substituted.
Level 1 exact-head affected build/tests/mechanical checks are green.
Level 2 retained Compute verifier-method integration suite is green on the same implementation SHA.
